title: Noise modulus from influence modulus
statement: Let $\eta:\mathbb N\to[0,1]$ and let $\delta\in[0,1/2]$. If $\delta>0$, define the resulting parameter to be $\eta$ evaluated at the inverse noise floor of $\delta$; if $\delta=0$, define it to be $0$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the inverse noise floor, so its meaning cannot be specified more fully from this payload.
